chapter: Second lining and the brass bands
title: Playing drums with little bands
summary: White says he played drums with small bands and filled in when a drummer was short, wearing the old Eureka-style cap.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I used to play with them little bands around, little different bands. Sometimes I used to play, sometimes I'd be short of a drummer. Man and Perez would come and get me. Man and Perez would say, all of us. I'd say, what? Come on, get your... I used to get my black. That time I used to have a black shirt, white band, a black shirt, black band, and a white shirt, and a tie, and my cap. Well, my cap used to be the old Ricker. Used to be the old Ricker band. I used to be with the old Rick in them. I used to be with all of them. Most of all of them. There ain't no place you can call. I used to be with the old Ricker band. Now, mostly, all of the musicians up the line, I know most of all of them. Some of them is dead. Some of them I done... You know what I mean? Some of them is done dead and I done forgot some of them. Some of them is dead. But outside of that, I know most of all of them. In the musicians you can call. I don't know nothing about.
